what: per-frame LiDAR BEV ground truth (occupancy / observed / camera-visible grids) on the v2ep EPISODE grid, one file per clip
label_only: built from the top LiDAR: a training TARGET and evaluation reference, never an inference input (inference is vision-only)
builder: TanitAD repo, TanitAD Research Lab/Architecture & Inference/Research/2026-09-13-bev-lidar-corpus-and-head (code/lidar_bev.py; loader code/bev_gt_loader.py)
checks_at_publish: file bytes == builder record; D: mirror sha256 == C: build cache sha256; builder ok == shipped set; 0 quarantined clips shipped

file_schema_example.frame_convention: +x forward, +y LEFT, +z UP; origin rear axle on the road plane

units.timestamp: microseconds on the clip clock (same clock as the camera timestamps parquet)

cartesian.row0: x in [0, cell_m); col0 is y = -y_half (RIGHT), +y is LEFT

polar.col0: +hfov/2 = LEFT (agrees with bev_aux.azimuth_column and psg_targets.azimuth_column; the opposite sense is R-2026-09-08-wpa-mirror)

file_schema_example.ground_plane: rig z = 0 (D-V5A-GROUND1; reproduced from LiDAR returns at -0.035 m)

provenance.codec: Draco (DracoPy); POSITION float32 in the LIDAR SENSOR frame
provenance.binding: LABEL ONLY. Inference is VISION-ONLY (PI, 2026-08-03). LiDAR must never reach an inference path.

file_schema_example.grid_note: `polar` above is polar24 (bev_aux drop-in); `polar48` is the head grid

time_grid.axis0: RAW v2ep frame index i, 0..T-1, on the episode grid of v2_compressed._resampled: t_query = linspace(t_cam[0], t_cam[-1], int(span_s*10)); pixels from camera frame searchsorted(t_cam, t_query)
time_grid.consumer_row: trunk STACKED ROW j reads raw frames j..j+2; its current frame -- and therefore its target -- is raw frame i = j + 2
time_grid.reference_instant: t_img_us = camera exposure timestamp of raw frame i
time_grid.spin_choice: LiDAR spin whose MIDPOINT is nearest t_img_us

file_schema_example.deskew_model: constant v + constant yaw-rate over the spin, per-point us timestamps, reference t_img_us, rotation +yaw_rate*dt (P0-measured sign)

third_state.occ: lidar_bev default rule: z in [0.30,3.00] m AND per-cell vertical spread >= 0.30 m
third_state.occ_zband: lidar_bev flat rule only (over-reports; kept for audit)
third_state.observed: RULE B (consumer default). cart: lidar_bev rule ~shadow | occ | n_pts>0. polar*: the SAME rule ported (lidar_bev.rasterise_polar `observed_npts`)
third_state.observed_shipped: RULE A, polar only: lidar_bev.rasterise_polar `observed` as shipped (~shadow | occ). MEASURED BIASED (p2b_observed_rule_probe.json): keeps occupied cells behind the first hit, drops free cells with returns
third_state.visible_first_hit: RULE C, polar only: ~shadow (cells up to the first occupied cell + 1)
third_state.cam_vis: uint8 round(255*fraction of 4x4 sub-samples x z in {0.3,1,2,3} m projecting into an OBSERVED pixel of the canonical frame); static per clip
third_state.v1_limit: a bearing with NO obstacle return is observed out to 60 m even when it points at sky; cart_n_pts_log2 lets a consumer tighten that

channels_units.cart_n_pts_log2: uint8 floor(log2(n_returns_in_cell + 1)), SATURATES at 8 (>= 255 returns); n>=1 <=> value>=1, n>=3 <=> >=2, n>=7 <=> >=3
